description:
The Scorecard helps golfers and golf groups record rounds, track handicaps and organise games — all in one easy-to-use app.

FIND ANY COURSE
• Course details come automatically from a worldwide golf course database. Search by name or town and use the course straight away — every golfer can, not only organisers.
• Course details may contain errors. A club's own scorecard can be used to check and correct them.

YOUR GOLF, CLEARLY RECORDED
• Record a round by choosing your course, tees and score.
• Follow how your handicap changes, with your own scoring statistics.
• Browse group handicap indexes, rankings and game results.
• Keep playing when connectivity is limited; saved changes sync when a connection returns.

BUILT FOR GROUPS
• Join the public golf community or accept an invitation to a private group.
• Group administrators maintain golfers and courses, send personal invitations and correct group scores.
• Create single-day or multi-day golf games, with leaderboards and shared results.

HANDICAP TRACKING
• Handicap calculations use the World Handicap System approach.
• Course rating, slope and tee selection are used in round calculations.
• Administrators can give a golfer a starting index until enough rounds have been entered.

YOUR ACCOUNT AND PRIVACY
• Email-and-password sign-in.
• No advertising or advertising tracking.
• Delete your account in the app using "Delete my account". Shared golf history is retained as explained in the privacy policy.

BETTER TOGETHER WITH THE MARKER
Use The Marker on the course to keep a hole-by-hole card for your foursome, or hand it to your caddie to score. Friends can follow the card live, even on an Apple Watch. When the round is done, the scores post straight into The Scorecard: handicaps, games and rankings update seamlessly. No retyping.
whatsNew:

notes:
The Scorecard 2.31.2 is a free golf score and handicap app. Anyone can apply to join the public group from the sign-in screen; private groups are for golfers who want their own group. No purchases or subscriptions.

WHAT IS NEW IN 2.31.2 (please check):
• Course search for every golfer: Enter > the Course list > first line "Find another course…". Type a course name or town (for example Pebble Beach), tap Find, then Check the course and Use this course. Course details come from a worldwide golf course database.
• New look and icon. The Day/Night button at the top switches the colours; night colours can be kept on all day.
• Rounds posted from our companion app The Marker show "▦ Card" in History (a read-only hole-by-hole card); My rounds shows scoring statistics for those rounds.
• A mistake on any form (for example a wrong email) shows a pop-up that stays until OK.
